research_scope: New controllable video and animation capability demos; verified primary sources, not an unverified daily popularity ranking.

rounds.title_zh: 角色手腕扭转不产生“糖纸拧巴坍缩”：单位双四元数蒙皮（DQS）与线性混合蒙皮（LBS）选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Wrist twist without candy-wrapper collapse: unit dual quaternion skinning (DQS) vs linear blend skinning (LBS) selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在前臂扭转 160° 的手腕中点环（w=0.50）处，传统线性混合蒙皮（LBS）因直接平均旋转矩阵引入 cos(80°)=0.1736 收缩因子，导致截面半径从 1.6000 u 暴跌至 0.2778 u（径向塌缩 82.64%，横截面积坍缩 96.98%）。
采用八维旋量流形上的单位双四元数蒙皮（DQS）对刚体螺旋变换插值并除以实部范数 ||b_r||，在全部 9 个袖套环上严格保持 R=1.6000 u（0.00% 径向塌缩，100.00% 面积守恒）。
60 实体 9 环×6 辐条手腕扭转卡尺台对比双四元数直接向量叉积与逐顶点 4×4 矩阵解包（8192 次 31.32 ms vs 36.05 ms，误差 7.02e-16 u），不冒充神经自动绑定推理。
conclusions_en: Under a 160° forearm twist at the w=0.50 midpoint ring, naive Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) averages rotation matrices by cos(80°)=0.1736, pinching radius from 1.6000 u down to 0.2778 u (82.64% radial shrink, 96.98% cross-sectional area collapse).
Unit Dual Quaternion Skinning (DQS) in Spin(3)⋉R³ normalizes blended screw transforms by ||b_r||, locking radius at R=1.6000 u across all 9 rings (0.00% radial shrink, 100.00% area retention).

The 60-solid 9-ring × 6-spoke wrist-twist caliper bench compares direct dual-quaternion cross-product evaluation against per-vertex 4×4 matrix unpacking (31.32 ms vs 36.05 ms at 8,192 passes, 7.02e-16 u error) without claiming neural auto-rigging.

rounds.title_zh: 三维丝带与扫掠管道过 S 型拐点不瞬间 180° 翻转拧麻花：Bishop 平行传输标架（PTF）与 Frenet-Serret 曲率标架选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: 3D ribbons and swept tubes without 180° inflection flips: Bishop parallel transport frame (PTF) vs Frenet-Serret curvature frame selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在三维 S 型曲线跨过 u=0 拐点（第 9→10 站）时，经典 Frenet-Serret 标架因二阶导数 r''(u) 变号发生 180.00° 瞬间翻转，将扫掠丝带拧成蝴蝶结麻花。
采用无三角函数代数二面角反射的 Bishop 平行传输标架（PTF）将拐点跳变锁死在 0.00°（全程 20 站最大步进二面角仅 17.51°），保持左右丝带导轨平行零自交。
65 实体 20 站点 S 型丝带台对比代数二面角反射传输与罗德里格斯 3×3 旋转矩阵（8192 次 70.93 ms vs 83.74 ms，误差 2.58e-16），不冒充神经相机轨迹扩散。
conclusions_en: Across the u=0 inflection point (station 9→10) of a 3D S-curve, the classical Frenet-Serret frame snaps 180.00° upside-down due to second-derivative sign reversal, twisting swept ribbons into a bowtie.
Trig-free algebraic Bishop Parallel Transport (PTF) locks the inflection crossing jump at 0.00° (with a 17.51° max dihedral step across all 20 stations), keeping ribbon rails parallel and untwisted.

The 65-solid 20-station S-curve ribbon bench compares algebraic dihedral reflection against trigonometric Rodrigues 3×3 rotation matrices (70.93 ms vs 83.74 ms at 8,192 passes, 2.58e-16 error) without claiming neural trajectory diffusion.

rounds.title_zh: 半透明烟雾与抠像边缘双线性过滤不冒黑边脏环：预乘关联 Alpha（Premultiplied Alpha）与直通 Alpha（Straight Alpha）选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Translucent sprites and video mattes without dark halo fringes: premultiplied associated alpha vs straight unassociated alpha selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在前景辐射度 1.00、天空背景 0.90 的双线性插值中点（t=0.50）处，直通非关联 Alpha 因透明像素 (0,0,0,0) 渗漏与 (1−t)² 二次衰减，导致边缘辐射度跌至 0.7000（比天空还暗 0.2000，损失 26.32% 光能）。
采用预乘关联 Alpha（C̃=αC）使双线性插值与 Porter-Duff OVER 合成严格可交换，在 17 个边缘抽头上保持 1.0000→0.9500→0.9000 单调平滑过渡（0.00% 黑边凹陷）。
58 实体 17 抽头轮廓光度计台对比无除法直接预乘合成与反预乘除法基线（1024 次 0.49 ms vs 1.85 ms，0 误差），不冒充神经视频抠像模型。
conclusions_en: At the t=0.50 bilinear midpoint between a 1.00 foreground and a 0.90 sky backdrop, Straight Unassociated Alpha leaks transparent black (0,0,0,0) and squares (1−t) into 0.25, dropping edge radiance to 0.7000 (-26.32% loss, darker than the sky).
Premultiplied Associated Alpha (C̃=αC) commutes with bilinear filtering and Porter-Duff OVER compositing, preserving a monotonic 1.0000→0.9500→0.9000 ramp across all 17 taps with 0.00% dark-halo dip.

The 58-solid 17-tap silhouette photometer bench compares division-free premultiplied OVER evaluation against per-sample alpha division unpremultiplication (0.49 ms vs 1.85 ms at 1,024 passes, 0 error) without claiming neural video matting.

rounds.title_zh: 高速刚体与弹道粒子不穿墙漏检（Bullet-Through-Paper）：连续扫掠球体碰撞检测（Swept-Sphere CCD）与离散帧末检测选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Fast projectiles and rigid bodies without wall tunneling: swept-sphere continuous collision detection (CCD) vs discrete step collision selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 当单帧位移步长 Δx=0.80 u 超过球体半径与薄墙半厚之和 2(R+h_wall)=0.72 u 时，离散帧末检测因 x₄=−0.40 u 与 x₅=+0.40 u 均未落入重叠区间而发生 100% 穿墙漏检（最大轨迹偏差 9.5200 u）。
采用闵可夫斯基和外扩的连续扫掠球体碰撞检测（Swept-Sphere CCD）闭式解出亚帧碰撞时刻 τ*=0.0500，在接触面 x*=−0.3600 u 处将剩余 95% 步长精确反弹至 x₅=−1.1200 u（0 穿墙）。
42 实体 11 帧步弹道屏障台对比闵可夫斯基闭式 TOI 求根与 52 步区间二分法（8192 次 1.67 ms vs 3.70 ms，提速 2.21×，误差 2.22e-16 u），不冒充神经世界模型。
conclusions_en: When the per-frame step stride Δx=0.80 u exceeds the combined overlap width 2(R+h_wall)=0.72 u, discrete end-of-step collision checks miss the [-0.36, +0.36] u barrier completely, tunneling from x₄=-0.40 u to x₅=+0.40 u (9.5200 u max trajectory error).

Swept-Sphere Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) expands the barrier by the Minkowski sum to x*=-0.3600 u, solves the exact Time-of-Impact τ*=0.0500, and reflects the remaining 95% step to x₅=-1.1200 u (0 tunneling).

The 42-solid 11-step ballistic barrier bench compares closed-form Minkowski slab TOI against 52-step binary bisection (1.67 ms vs 3.70 ms at 8,192 passes, 2.21× speedup, 2.22e-16 u error) without claiming neural physics world models.

rounds.title_zh: 动画曲线与曝光关键帧在平坦段前不反向过冲：Fritsch-Carlson 单调三次 Hermite 插值（PCHIP）与 Catmull-Rom 样条选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Keyframe curves without plateau overshoot or ground dip: Fritsch-Carlson monotonic cubic Hermite (PCHIP) vs Catmull-Rom spline selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在 4 关键帧台阶序列 y=[0.00, 0.00, 2.00, 2.00] 上，非受限 Catmull-Rom 样条因跨段中心差分赋予平坦段入口 m₂=+1.00 斜率，导致 t=2.375 过冲至 2.1465 u、t=0.625 穿地至 −0.1465 u（峰谷振荡跨度 0.2930 u）。
采用 Fritsch-Carlson 单调三次 Hermite（PCHIP）在 Δ_{k−1}·Δ_k ≤ 0 时自动锁零切线并施加 α²+β² ≤ 9 信任域，在全部 25 个站点严格保持 0.0000 u 过冲与 0.0000 u 穿地。
58 实体 25 站点关键帧 F-Curve 台对比霍纳嵌套多项式求值与展开幂函数基线（8192 次 7.79 ms vs 14.60 ms，提速 1.88×，0 误差），不冒充神经补帧推理。
conclusions_en: On a 4-keyframe step-to-plateau sequence y=[0.00, 0.00, 2.00, 2.00], unconstrained Catmull-Rom assigns m₂=+1.00 entering the flat hold, bulging above the ceiling to 2.1465 u at t=2.375 and dipping below ground to -0.1465 u at t=0.625 (0.2930 u total ringing span).

Fritsch-Carlson Monotonic Cubic Hermite (PCHIP) clamps tangents to zero whenever Δ_{k−1}·Δ_k ≤ 0 and enforces α²+β² ≤ 9, locking all 25 stations within [0.0000, 2.0000] u with 0.0000 u overshoot and 0.0000 u undershoot.

The 58-solid 25-station F-curve bench compares Horner-factored cubic evaluation against expanded Bernstein power evaluation (7.79 ms vs 14.60 ms at 8,192 passes, 1.88× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural video frame interpolation.

rounds.title_zh: 掠射角金属高光不越界爆白：Smith 高度相关微表面几何遮蔽（Height-Correlated G₂）与无遮蔽分母除零选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Grazing-angle metallic highlights without specular blowout: height-correlated Smith-GGX visibility vs unmasked denominator selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在 81.0° 掠射角（μ_v=0.1564，粗糙度 α=0.55）下，漏掉 Smith G₂ 几何遮蔽项会导致 Cook-Torrance 分母 1/(4μ_lμ_v) 失控暴涨，使镜面反射率飙至 R_spec=1.6816（虚高 3.61×，超白炉能量上限 +68.16%）。
采用代数约分后的 Smith 高度相关可见性函数 V(μ_l,μ_v,α)=G₂/(4μ_lμ_v) 精确消除 1/μ_v 奇点，将 81.0° 反射率锁定在 R_spec=0.4654 ≤ 1.0000（全部 17 个视角 0.00% 能量越界）。
58 实体 17 视角 BRDF 测角仪台对比纯代数约分根式与三角函数 tan(acos) Lambda 基线（8192 次 6.81 ms vs 14.73 ms，提速 2.16×，误差 1.67e-16），不冒充神经逆向材质分解。
conclusions_en: At an 81.0° grazing view angle (μ_v=0.1564, roughness α=0.55), omitting Smith G₂ masking leaves the 1/(4μ_lμ_v) foreshortening denominator unchecked, blowing specular reflectance up to R_spec=1.6816 (3.61× physical, +68.16% fake energy above 1.0).

Cancelled Height-Correlated Smith-GGX visibility V(μ_l,μ_v,α)=G₂/(4μ_lμ_v) eliminates the 1/μ_v singularity algebraically, bounding 81.0° reflectance at R_spec=0.4654 ≤ 1.0000 (0.00% white-furnace violation across all 17 angles).

The 58-solid 17-angle BRDF goniometer bench compares cancelled algebraic visibility against trigonometric tan(acos) Lambda evaluation (6.81 ms vs 14.73 ms at 8,192 passes, 2.16× speedup, 1.67e-16 error) without claiming neural inverse rendering.

rounds.title_zh: 长时程着色器动画与大坐标世界不卡顿不冻结：Kahan 误差补偿累加 + 周期取模重锚定与单精度 float32 裸累加选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Long-horizon shader animation without float32 freeze: Kahan compensated summation and modulo-2π phase wrapping vs naive float32 accumulation selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在 IEEE-754 单精度（float32）基数达到 2¹⁸=262,144.0 时，最小精度间距 1 ULP=0.03125；直接累加 Δφ=0.0120 rad（小于 0.5 ULP=0.015625）会被向偶舍入 100% 吞没，300 步后相位死锁在 0.0000 rad。
采用 Kahan 误差补偿累加配合 mod 2π 周期重锚定将累加器锁在 [0, 2π) 高精度区间（ULP=4.77e-7），300 步后精确到达 Φ=3.6000 rad（206.3°，相位丢失 0.00%）。
56 实体 16 站点相位时计台对比单精度 Kahan 周期累加与 BigInt 10¹² 缩放定点基线（误差仅 1.43e-7 rad），不冒充长时程视频扩散记忆模型。
conclusions_en: At an IEEE-754 binary32 (float32) base epoch of 2¹⁸=262,144.0, 1 ULP equals 0.03125; adding a sub-tick increment Δφ=0.0120 rad (< 0.5 ULP=0.015625) rounds back to 262,144.0 every tick, freezing phase at 0.0000 rad (-100% motion loss).

Kahan Compensated Summation combined with modulo-2π phase wrapping keeps the accumulator in [0, 2π) (ULP=4.77e-7) and tracks rounding remainders, reaching exact Φ=3.6000 rad (206.3°, 0.00% loss) across 300 sub-ticks.

The 56-solid 16-station chronometer bench compares float32 Kahan modulo accumulation against scaled BigInt 10¹² fixed-point arithmetic (1.43e-7 rad max discrepancy) without claiming long-horizon video diffusion.

rounds.title_zh: 远景法线贴图不闪烁不爆高光萤火虫噪点：Toksvig 法向长度方差转粗糙度补偿与朴素法向重归一化选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Distant normal maps without specular fireflies: Toksvig normal-variance roughness mip-filtering vs naive mip renormalization selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在覆盖 ±35° 交错微凹凸的远景像素中，Mipmap 平均后的法向模长缩短为 ||n̄||=0.8192；朴素 normalize(n̄) 直接丢弃模长并保持 α₀=0.15 不变，导致 GGX 高光峰值虚高 10.81×（D=14.1471 vs 1.3084），引发满屏闪烁噪点。
采用 Toksvig 法向方差过滤在归一化前提取方差 σ_n²=(1−||n̄||)/||n̄||=0.2208，将有效粗糙度展宽至 α_eff=0.4932，抑制 90.75% 的虚假高光萤火虫峰值。
58 实体 17 站点法向 Mip 检验台对比 O(1) 未归一化模长闭式解与 64 抽头亚像素超采样求和（8192 次 6.60 ms vs 95.90 ms，提速 14.54×，误差 7.21e-13），不冒充神经时空降噪器。
conclusions_en: Across a ±35° micro-bump footprint, hardware mipmap averaging shortens the mean normal length to ||n̄||=0.8192; calling normalize(n̄) with fixed roughness α₀=0.15 erases sub-pixel variance and inflates the GGX NDF peak by 10.81× (D=14.1471 vs 1.3084).
Toksvig Normal-Variance Filtering reads r=||n̄|| before normalizing and adds σ_n²=(1−r)/r=0.2208 into α_eff=0.4932, suppressing 90.75% of distant specular firefly spikes.

The 58-solid 17-station normal-mip bench compares O(1) Toksvig length variance against 64-tap footprint supersampling (6.60 ms vs 95.90 ms at 8,192 passes, 14.54× speedup, 7.21e-13 error) without claiming neural spatio-temporal denoisers.

rounds.title_zh: 远景建筑贴花与跑道标线不闪烁不穿模：反转 Z 浮点深度缓冲（Reversed-Z Float32）与传统正向 Z 选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Distant decals and horizons without Z-fighting: Reversed-Z float32 depth buffer vs standard Forward-Z selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在近裁剪面 z_near=0.10 m、距离 z=4096 m 处，传统正向 Z（d=1.0−z_near/z）将深度挤压在 1.0 附近（ULP=2⁻²⁴），导致最小可分辨间距恶化至 10.00 m，相距 0.25 m 的贴花在后 3 个倍频程站点完全坍缩为 Δd=0。
采用反转 Z 浮点深度映射（d=z_near/z，Near→1, Far→0）利用 float32 在 0.0 附近的动态指数下移（E=−16），在 4096 m 处实现 0.000305 m（0.31 毫米）分辨率，精度提升 32,768× 且全 13 站 0 次 Z-Fighting。
46 实体 13 倍频程深度测距台对比 IEEE-754 闭式指数 ULP 与 DataView 位操作 nextafterf 基线（8192 次 8.81 ms vs 55.98 ms，提速 6.35×，0 误差），不冒充单目深度估计推理。
conclusions_en: At distance z=4,096 m with near clip z_near=0.10 m, Standard Forward-Z (d=1.0−z_near/z) packs depth against 1.0 (ULP=2⁻²⁴), degrading minimum resolvable separation to 10.00 m and collapsing a 0.25 m decal into Δd=0 across 3 distant stations.

Reversed-Z Float32 mapping (d=z_near/z, Near→1, Far→0) leverages float32 exponent scaling near 0.0 (E=−16) to resolve 0.000305 m (0.31 mm) at 4,096 m—a 32,768× precision gain with 0 Z-fighting stations.

The 46-solid 13-octave rangefinder bench compares closed-form IEEE-754 exponent ULP against DataView bitwise nextafterf extraction (8.81 ms vs 55.98 ms at 8,192 passes, 6.35× speedup, 0 error) without claiming monocular neural depth estimation.

rounds.title_zh: 亚像素重采样不冒吉布斯黑边与棋盘水波纹：Mitchell-Netravali (B=1/3, C=1/3) 单位分解三次滤波核选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Sub-pixel resampling without Gibbs ringing or ripples: Mitchell-Netravali (B=1/3, C=1/3) cubic reconstruction filter selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在单位阶跃边缘重采样中，过锐化基数三次核（B=0, C=1.0）因外侧负旁瓣达 −0.1250，在阶跃两侧产生 +0.1465 白边过冲与 −0.1465 黑边下冲（峰谷振铃总跨度 0.2930）。
沿二阶精度线 B+2C=1 选取 Mitchell-Netravali 平衡甜点（B=1/3, C=1/3），在全部 25 个亚像素站点严格保持单位分解 Σw_m≡1.000000（零水波纹），并将旁瓣过冲压至 +0.0353（削减 75.93% 吉布斯振铃）。
58 实体 25 站点亚像素重采样台对比无分支霍纳 4 抽头多项式与分段 Math.abs/Math.pow 基线（8192 次 12.14 ms vs 29.34 ms，提速 2.42×，误差 1.33e-15），不冒充神经超分辨率推理。
conclusions_en: Across a unit step transition, an over-sharpened cardinal cubic filter (B=0, C=1.0) exhibits a -0.1250 negative side-lobe, producing +0.1465 bright overshoot and -0.1465 dark undershoot halos (0.2930 peak-to-peak Gibbs ringing span).
Selecting Mitchell-Netravali (B=1/3, C=1/3) on the B+2C=1 locus preserves exact Partition of Unity Σw_m≡1.000000 across all 25 stations and bounds overshoot to +0.0353 (75.93% ringing reduction).

The 58-solid 25-station sub-pixel resampler bench compares branchless Horner 4-tap polynomials against piecewise Math.abs/Math.pow branching (12.14 ms vs 29.34 ms at 8,192 passes, 2.42× speedup, 1.33e-15 error) without claiming neural super-resolution.

rounds.title_zh: 平行光阴影随相机平移不发生边缘锯齿蠕动：光源空间纹素网格整数对齐（Texel-Grid Snapping）与未对齐阴影游动选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Directional shadows without edge swimming: light-space texel-grid snapping vs continuous frustum tracking selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在单纹素宽 Δ_texel=0.2500 m 的跟随式正交阴影贴图中，若视锥中心随相机以连续亚纹素步长（0.035 m/帧）平移，静态建筑阴影边界会在 [0.8550, 1.1000] m 间发生峰谷跨度达 0.2450 m（98.0% 纹素宽）的锯齿状蠕动闪烁。
采用外接球定宽配合光源空间纹素整数倍对齐 C_snap=⌊C_raw/Δ_texel+0.5⌋·Δ_texel，使世界空间纹素晶格完全锁定，静态阴影边界在全部 17 帧中恒为 1.0000 m（0.0000 m 蠕动）。
58 实体 17 平移步阴影晶格台对比 O(1) 倒数取整闭式解与 64 纹素视口扫描基线（8192 次 4.05 ms vs 46.13 ms，提速 11.40×，0 误差），不冒充神经阴影生成推理。
conclusions_en: When an orthographic shadow frustum (Δ_texel=0.2500 m) translates continuously by sub-texel camera steps (0.035 m/frame), a static building's rasterized shadow boundary oscillates across [0.8550, 1.1000] m in a 0.2450 m sawtooth wave (98.0% of a texel width).

Bounding-sphere width locking combined with light-space texel-grid snapping C_snap=⌊C_raw/Δ_texel+0.5⌋·Δ_texel pins the world-space texel lattice, locking the shadow boundary at 1.0000 m across all 17 steps with 0.0000 m crawl.

The 58-solid 17-pan shadow cascade bench compares O(1) reciprocal floor snapping against 64-texel lattice scanning (4.05 ms vs 46.13 ms at 8,192 passes, 11.40× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural shadow synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 弹性形变提取刚体旋转不偏向首轴：最优正交极分解（Polar Decomposition F=R·S）与顺序 Gram-Schmidt 偏置选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Co-rotational elasticity without axial skew bias: optimal Polar decomposition (F=R·S) vs sequential Gram-Schmidt selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在真实刚体旋转 15.00° 叠加 γ=0.60 对称剪切的变形梯度 F=R(15°)·S(0.60) 下，顺序 Gram-Schmidt 正交化因盲目将第一列锁死为主轴，提取出 45.96° 旋转角（凭空注入 +30.96° 虚假旋转扭矩，最大偏置达 +38.66°）。
采用最优正交极分解（Polar Decomposition F=R·S）最小化 ||F−R||_F² 并保持拉伸张量 S=RᵀF 严格对称（缺陷 0.0000），在全部 17 个剪切站点精确还原 15.00° 真实旋转角（0.00° 偏置）。
58 实体 17 站点共旋剪切台对比反对称迹闭式极分解与 12 步 Higham 逆转置牛顿迭代（8192 次 21.19 ms vs 53.84 ms，提速 2.54×，误差 3.55e-15°），不冒充神经连续介质仿真。
conclusions_en: Under a deformation gradient F=R(15°)·S(0.60) combining a 15.00° rotation with γ=0.60 symmetric shear, sequential Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization locks onto column 1 and outputs 45.96° (+30.96° phantom torque bias, +38.66° max bias).

rounds.title_zh: 陡峭置换山脊掠射视角不穿峰不裂层：二进重心位移微网格（DMM）与 POM 视差步进选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Grazing displacement silhouettes without ridge tunneling: barycentric displaced micro-mesh (DMM) vs POM ray-marching selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在峰值高度 H=1.8000 u、半宽 w=0.25 u 的陡峭山脊掠射轮廓测试中，固定步长视差遮挡步进（POM Δx=0.40 u）因采样点 x∈{−0.20, +0.20} u 跨过 x=0.00 u 峰顶，导致 y∈[1.00, 1.80] u 的 9/17 条视线全部穿峰漏检（有效轮廓坍缩至 0.9491 u，丢失 47.27% 峰值高度）。
采用 2^4=16 段规则二进重心位移微网格（DMM）配合闭式线性求交 t*=(y_ray−H_k)/(H_{k+1}−H_k)，在全部 17 条掠射视线实现 0 穿透漏检与 0.00% 削顶损失（第 13 条视线 y=1.5000 u 精确命中侧翼 x*=−0.0705 u）。
58 实体 17 站点轮廓检验台对比闭式微段线性求交与 48 步二分求根基线（8192 次 14.22 ms vs 25.73 ms，提速 1.81×，误差 3.89e-16），不冒充神经材质生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 grazing silhouette rays targeting a sharp ridge (H=1.8000 u, half-width w=0.25 u), coarse fixed-step POM ray-marching (Δx=0.40 u, sampling x∈{−0.20, +0.20} u) straddles the crest and causes 9/17 rays to tunnel straight through the peak (collapsing silhouette height to 0.9491 u, a -47.27% loss).

A 2^4=16 dyadic Barycentric Displaced Micro-Mesh (DMM) with closed-form linear segment intersection t*=(y_ray−H_k)/(H_{k+1}−H_k) captures all 17/17 rays (hitting ray 13 y=1.5000 u at x*=−0.0705 u) with 0 tunneled rays and 0.00% crest loss.

The 58-solid 17-station silhouette bench compares closed-form linear micro-segment intersection against 48-step bisection root-finding (14.22 ms vs 25.73 ms at 8,192 passes, 1.81× speedup, 3.89e-16 error) without claiming neural material synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 屏幕空间接触阴影不留远景墙面假黑晕：有限厚度区间门控与 2.5D 无限深柱选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Screen-space contact shadows without detached black halos: finite-thickness depth-slab gating vs 2.5D infinite-pillar testing selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在正表面深度 z_front=1.00 m、厚度 Δτ=0.25 m（占据 [1.00, 1.25] m）的前景薄柱与远景背景墙组成的 17 站阴影步进测试中，朴素 2.5D 单边判据 z_ray≥z_buf 将薄柱视为延伸至 +∞ 的实心深柱，导致柱体后方空气中的 12/17 条背景光线全部被误涂黑为悬浮假黑晕（第 10 站 z=2.00 m 处 V=0.0）。
采用直接倒数反转 Z 线性化（z=z_near/d_rev）配合双侧有限厚度区间门控 |z_ray−(z_front+½Δτ)|≤½Δτ，100% 保留前 5 站真实接触阴影并放行柱后全部 12 站背景光线（V=1.0，0/17 悬浮假黑晕）。
58 实体 17 站点接触阴影台对比直接倒数深度门控与 4×4 齐次逆投影矩阵还原基线（8192 次 0.29 ms vs 1.30 ms，提速 4.45×，误差 0），不冒充神经环境光遮蔽。
conclusions_en: Across 17 shadow-ray stations behind a foreground post at z_front=1.00 m with physical thickness Δτ=0.25 m ([1.00, 1.25] m), the naive 2.5D one-sided test z_ray≥z_buf treats the post as an infinite pillar [1.00 m, +∞), falsely blackening all 12/17 empty-air background stations (visibility V=0.0 at station 10 z=2.00 m).

Direct reciprocal Reversed-Z linearization (z=z_near/d_rev) with centered finite-thickness slab gating |z_ray−(z_front+½Δτ)|≤½Δτ preserves all 5/5 true contact shadows while letting all 12/12 background rays pass unoccluded (V=1.0, 0/17 false halos).

The 58-solid 17-station contact-shadow bench compares direct reciprocal-Z slab gating against 4×4 inverse-projection unprojection (0.29 ms vs 1.30 ms at 8,192 passes, 4.45× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural ambient occlusion.

rounds.title_zh: 透视斜面贴图在对角线处不折断不游动：透视正确双曲 (u/w)/(1/w) 插值与屏幕仿射选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Perspective textures without diagonal kinking or swim: hyperbolic (u/w)/(1/w) interpolation vs screen-space affine lerp selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在近端深度 z₀=1.00 m（u₀=0.0）至远端深度 z₁=9.00 m（u₁=1.0，9:1 透视缩短）的 17 站屏幕插值测试中，朴素屏幕空间仿射插值忽略 1/z 透视除法，在屏幕中点 s=0.50 处输出 u=0.5000（偏离真实值 u=0.1000 达 +0.4000，最大畸变 +0.5000），引发对角线贴图折断与镜头旋转晃动。
采用 Heckbert-Moreton 透视正确双曲倒数插值 ((1−s)(u₀/z₀)+s(u₁/z₁))/((1−s)(1/z₀)+s(1/z₁))，在 s=0.50 处精确还原世界深度 z=1.8000 m 与 u=0.1000（全 17 站 0.0000 纹理游动）。
58 实体 17 站点透视插值台对比预计算顶点倒数线性插值与逐像素 3D 射线-平面求交基线（8192 次 0.46 ms vs 7.89 ms，提速 17.22×，误差 2.22e-16），不冒充神经视角合成。
conclusions_en: Across a 17-station screen-space span with a 9:1 depth foreshortening ratio from z₀=1.00 m (u₀=0.0) to z₁=9.00 m (u₁=1.0), naive screen-space affine interpolation outputs u=0.5000 at midpoint s=0.50 instead of the true u=0.1000 (+0.4000 midpoint swim, +0.5000 max distortion), causing diagonal checkerboard kinking and texture swimming.

Heckbert-Moreton perspective-correct hyperbolic interpolation ((1−s)(u₀/z₀)+s(u₁/z₁))/((1−s)(1/z₀)+s(1/z₁)) recovers exact world depth z=1.8000 m and u=0.1000 at s=0.50 with 0.0000 UV swim across all 17 stations.

The 58-solid 17-station perspective bench compares precomputed vertex (1/w, u/w) interpolation against per-pixel 3D ray-plane intersection (0.46 ms vs 7.89 ms at 8,192 passes, 17.22× speedup, 2.22e-16 error) without claiming neural view warping.

rounds.title_zh: 对称镜像 UV 法线贴图不裂开中线阴阳缝：MikkTSpace 逐像素正交化与手性符号 w 选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Mirrored UV normal maps without centerline lighting seams: MikkTSpace Gram-Schmidt and handedness w selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在插值歪斜 25.0°（夹角 65.0°）、斜面倾角 35.0°、跨越对称中线镜像 UV 半壳（第 8..16 站 w=−1）的 17 站测试中，朴素无符号未正交化叉积 B=N×T_raw 残留 25.00° 歪斜并在全部 9 个镜像站点将副切线反转 180°，导致世界法线发生 70.00° 阴阳倒转。
采用 MikkTSpace 逐像素施密特正交化 T'=normalize(T−(N·T)N) 配合第 4 分量手性符号 B=w·(N×T')，在全部 17 站严格锁死 90.00° 正交角与 0.00° 世界法线误差。
59 实体 17 站点 TBN 测角仪台对比单步施密特手性叉积与屏幕空间余切偏导雅可比基线（8192 次 1.55 ms vs 5.11 ms，提速 3.30×，误差 1.11e-16），不冒充神经贴图生成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 symmetric mesh stations with a 25.0° interpolated N-T skew (65.0° angle) and a 35.0° bevel across a centerline mirror seam (w=−1 on stations 8..16), naive unsigned cross products B=N×T_raw leave a 25.00° orthogonality defect and flip the bitangent 180° across all 9 mirrored stations (70.00° world-normal inversion).

MikkTSpace per-pixel Gram-Schmidt re-orthogonalization T'=normalize(T−(N·T)N) with 4th-component handedness scaling B=w·(N×T') locks ∠(N,T')≡90.00° and 0.00° world-normal error across all 17 stations.

The 59-solid 17-station TBN goniometer bench compares direct Gram-Schmidt + w-sign evaluation against screen-space cotangent derivative Jacobians (1.55 ms vs 5.11 ms at 8,192 passes, 3.30× speedup, 1.11e-16 error) without claiming neural texture synthesis.

rounds.title_zh: 多层交错半透明玻璃与烟雾不闪烁互换：McGuire-Bavoil 加权混合顺序无关半透明（WBOIT）选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Overlapping transparency without sorting pops: McGuire-Bavoil Weighted Blended OIT (WBOIT) vs unsorted OVER selection FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在近景亮层（z=1.00 m, C=0.90, α=0.75）与远景暗层（第 8 站 z=3.25 m, C=0.15, α=0.75，正确排序合成值 0.7031）发生绘制顺序反转时，朴素未排序 OVER 因远景暗层覆盖近景亮层，导致合成亮度暴跌至 0.2813（产生 −0.4219 / −60.00% 的倒置跳变）。
采用 McGuire-Bavoil 加权混合顺序无关半透明（WBOIT），通过可交换深度加权加法累加 Σ(α_k·C_k·w(z_k)) 与透射率乘法累乘 Π(1−α_k)，在正逆序提交下输出比特级一致的 C=0.8375（全 17 站顺序跳变差 0.0000）。
58 实体 17 站点半透明分光台对比单遍无排序 WBOIT 与逐像素数组排序 A-Buffer 基线（8192 次 1.26 ms vs 22.25 ms，提速 17.64×，误差 0），不冒充神经图层分解。
conclusions_en: When a near bright layer (z=1.00 m, C=0.90, α=0.75) is submitted before a far dark layer (station 8 z=3.25 m, C=0.15, α=0.75, true sorted OVER = 0.7031), naive unsorted Porter-Duff OVER overwrites the foreground with the dark background layer, collapsing brightness to 0.2813 (−0.4219 / −60.00% inversion pop).

McGuire-Bavoil Weighted Blended OIT (WBOIT) combines commutative depth-weighted color addition Σ(α_k·C_k·w(z_k)) with multiplicative revealage Π(1−α_k), producing bit-identical C=0.8375 regardless of submission order (0.0000 order-flip discrepancy across all 17 stations).

The 58-solid 17-station OIT bench compares single-pass commutative WBOIT against per-pixel sorted A-Buffers (1.26 ms vs 22.25 ms at 8,192 passes, 17.64× speedup, 0 error) without claiming neural layer decomposition.
